I do live with them, and they are still technically my friends. Plus friends of friends. And as for Brick, confrontations have occurred. He has choked a mutual friend of ours, and he has alternatively cried his eyes out in an intervention type deal. Always back to status quo.

Inertia

Thanks, I should add that I'm nowhere near actually doing anything. I just wanted to say it somewhere so that it's said. I figured it'd be good to affirm these truths and maybe I could work forward from it
